item.title: BD RMG exports to EU dwindles by 4pc: EPB data
item.description: Bangladesh's ready-made garment (RMG) exports to the European Union (EU) fell by 4.14 per cent year-on-year to US$9.46 billion in the first half (July-December) of the 2025-26 fiscal year, down from $9.86 billion in the same period of the previous fiscal year, according to data from the Export Promotion Bureau (EPB).The EU remains the largest export destination for Bangladesh's garment sector, accounting for about 48.84 per cent of the country's total export earnings. item.title: Tarique starts polls tour of 17 dists from tomorrow
item.description: BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman is set to begin a tour of 17 districts as part of his election campaign for the upcoming national election, starting from Sylhet on January 22.The campaign will officially kick off in Sylhet-known as the holy land of Peer-Aulia-where Tarique Rahman will address a major rally. item.title: Ronaldo wins legal dispute with Juventus over salary payments
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo has emerged victorious in his long-running dispute with former employers Juventus regarding wages that initially went unpaid. The Portuguese superstar, along with his teammates in Turin, agreed to defer certain salary payments during the COVID-19 pandemic. item.description: Barrister Toby Cadman, the British international human rights lawyer, has stepped down from the post of special advisor to the chief prosecutor of the International Crimes Tribunal.He did not specify any reason, confirmed that his contract term had expired and that it would not be renewed.In a Facebook post, Cadman wrote that his contract expired last November and he was offered an extension.
